THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

LAND ACQUISITION ACT(CHAPTER 460)
AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
( Notice under Section 7)
My Ref. No.: KDS/KGK/4/2/2013/02/02. Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands:
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:-

The allotment of Land called “Ambagahamula Watta” in total extent of about 0.0185 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 169 in Cadastral Map No. 320314, Block No. 04, Sheet No. 4 and dated on 25.08.2016, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Ketawala in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows.
Lot No. 169 - Name of the Land: Ambagahamula Watta: Claimants: 1. Mrs. Weange Gedara Chandima Kumari Madubhashini, Ankendagolla, Ketawala, Lewula; Extent: 0.0185 Hectare.

Boundaries: North: Lot No. 59,58 and 55; East: Lot No. 104; South: Lot No. 172, 171 and 170; West: Lot No. 170 and 60. All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale on the 21 day of December 2016 at 2.30 p.m. and are hereby requested to notiufy to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 14 day of December 2016, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their clams for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. B. M. P. G. P. V. BANDARA, Divisional Secretary, Kandy Four Garavets & Gangawata Korale Division, Kandy District. Divisional Secretariat, Kandy Four Garavets & Gangawata Korale Division, 9th November, 2016. 11 - 1266
